verdict.rationale: Open WebUI exposes an API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only shows prose docs: API keys that let external code call the UI's endpoints, and an OpenAI-compatible gateway API reference page. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any of the candidate docs paths, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.
